notes.title: Season 2 Released
notes.content:
Hello, Commanders!

The wait is over! The update has just been released, marking the official start of Season 2 in Mechanines Tower Defense!

Changes:

 Corby's Line 1 upgrade 3 no longer allows the buffed EvoDog to target flying Mechanoids.
 Corby’s buffs have been adjusted to:

 Level 1: +1 Damage, +0.05 Attack Speed, +1 Range
 Level 2: +2 Damage, +0.1 Attack Speed, +2 Range
 Level 3: +3 Damage, +0.15 Attack Speed, +3 Range
 Level 4: +4 Damage (+15% of Corby’s damage), +0.25 Attack Speed, +4 Range

 Corby can now buff other Corbys.
 Corby’s initial attack speed changed from 0.15 -> 0.1.
 Corby’s starting damage increased from 0 -> 5.
 Corby’s Line 1 upgrade 3 now gives +1 range instead of +2.
 Corby’s target can now be selected in the UI.
 One-star cards are no longer free.
 Toggle Speed bind changed from Space -> 'Z'.
 Bug fixes and optimizations.
 Leaderboard Season 2 is live!
 Reroll the P.O.D. buff (flag) for 600 DogCoins.
 Corby’s bullet speed increased.
 Corby’s Line 1 upgrade 3 DogCoin cost increased from 1500 -> 1700.
 Corby’s three-star card range changed from +6 -> +5.
 Corby’s two-star card damage changed from +7 -> +6.
 Corby’s three-star card damage changed from +10 -> +11.
 Minimum value to purchase the “PetLab more card” upgrade increased from 11 -> 24.
 Quality of Life (QOL) improvements.


Over and out!

notes.title: Mechanines Tower Defense Playtest
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

I'm Dr. Goldenise and we are in a critical situation that requires your immediate assistance. We, the scientists at PetLab, are developing the Project Phoenix, a machine capable of time travel to prevent the rise of the Mechanoids. Unfortunately, our enemies have discovered our hideout, and now we need your field training to ensure our protection.

On September 28th and 29th, we will be conducting high-risk and highly visible experiments. Your participation will be crucial to the success of the operation.

The board has announced that the top commander in each category (one, two, three, and four initial paths) will receive an exclusive VIP access card to the PetLab (key to the game).

I’m counting on you, Commander! Together, we will ensure the success of Project Phoenix and save the humanity.

Over and out!
